gloss: to approve; to authorize; to ratify; to recognize officially

definitions.gloss: to approve; to authorize; to ratify; to recognize officially

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{承認|しょうにん}する。
{新薬|しんやく}が{政府|せいふ}に{承認|しょうにん}された。
examples.english: The new drug was approved by the government.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}が{新|あたら}しい{加盟国|かめいこく}を{承認|しょうにん}した。
examples.english: The United Nations recognized the new member state.

notes:
Formal approval or official recognition by an authority. Used in government, business, legal, and diplomatic contexts. Implies that something has been examined and officially accepted.

PARTICLE PATTERN:
- [proposal/document]を{承認|しょうにん}する: to approve [something]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {承認|しょうにん}を{受|う}ける: to receive approval
- {承認|しょうにん}を{得|え}る: to obtain approval
- {承認|しょうにん}{手続|てつづ}き: approval procedure
- {国家|こっか}{承認|しょうにん}: state recognition (diplomatic)
- {薬事|やくじ}{承認|しょうにん}: pharmaceutical approval

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {許可|きょか}する: to permit — grants permission to do something; {承認|しょうにん} approves something that has been proposed or submitted
- {認|みと}める: to recognize/acknowledge — broader and less formal
- {了承|りょうしょう}する: to consent/accept — accepting a situation with understanding, less about formal authority
